business_summary: Sasol Limited operates as a chemical and energy company in South Africa, Mozambique, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers bitumen, industrial heating fuels, naphtha, lubricants and lubricant base oils, liquefied petroleum gas, automotive and industrial lubricants, greases, cleansers and degreasers, automotive fuels, and burner fuels, as well as illuminating paraffin transport fuels, such as petrol, diesel, and jet fuels. The company also provides methane rich and natural gas; leaners and degreasers; hydrocarbon liquid fuel; specialty gas, butane, and propane; gasoline, kerosene (jet fuel), olefins, alcohols, polymers, solvents, surfactants, co-monomers, ammonia, methanol, crude tar acids, sulphur, and fuel oil; gas to liquid fuel; sustainable aviation fuel; and other fuels, as well as engages in the wholesale of motor fuels. In addition, it is involved in engineering, research and development, and technology transfer; management of cash resources, investments, and procurement of loans; development and implementation of international gas to liquid and CTL ventures; marketing of fuels and lubricants; production, trading, and transportation of oil products, petrochemicals and chemical products, and derivatives; and coal mining activities. The company serves adhesives, agriculture and forestry, automotive and transportation, aviation, burner fuels, chemicals, construction and materials, corrosion protection, electrical and electronics, flavors and fragrances, furniture, health and medical, household and consumer goods, industrial products, lubricants, manufacturing, mining, packaging, paints and coatings, personal care, pharmaceuticals, plastics and polymers, publishing and inks, pulp and paper, rubber and tires, specialty graphite, steel and foundry, textile and leather, water treatment, and other industries. Sasol Limited was founded in 1950 and is based in Sandton, South Africa.
business_summary_ko: Sasol Limited는 남아프리카, 모잠비크, 미국, 유럽 및 전 세계에서 화학 및 에너지 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 역청, 산업용 난방 연료, 나프타, 윤활유 및 윤활유 기유, 액화 석유 가스, 자동차 및 산업용 윤활유, 그리스, 세정제 및 탈지제, 자동차 연료 및 버너 연료뿐만 아니라 휘발유, 디젤 및 제트 연료와 같은 조명 파라핀 운송 연료도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 메탄이 풍부한 천연가스도 제공합니다. 희박제 및 탈지제; 탄화수소 액체 연료; 특수 가스, 부탄, 프로판; 가솔린, 등유(제트 연료), 올레핀, 알코올, 중합체, 용매, 계면활성제, 공단량체, 암모니아, 메탄올, 조타르산, 황 및 연료유; 가스에서 액체 연료로; 지속 가능한 항공 연료; 및 기타 연료를 취급하며, 자동차 연료 도매업에도 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 엔지니어링, 연구 개발, 기술 이전에도 참여하고 있습니다. 현금 자원 관리, 투자 및 대출 조달; 액체 및 CTL 벤처에 대한 국제 가스 개발 및 구현; 연료 및 윤활유 마케팅; 석유제품, 석유제품의 생산, 무역, 운송
